protocol: Frozen photo-relative-v3 candidates; pixel-only scores; no fitting or threshold changes. Empty-oracle effective mass returns no search result.
renderer: 512RGB PNG; Pillow LANCZOS tile128→64 for4grid; native64 for8grid; resized real-schoolbus cutout52x22/105x44 withalpha>32 evaluation only

grover_probability_summary.semantics: Ideal exact-statevector probabilities after the browser first-peak iteration rule, not sampled outcomes. Empty marks give a uniform theoretical distribution at zero rounds; the UI returns no search result, so a separate effective mass treats those scenes as zero.
grover_probability_summary.formula: (|T intersect S|/M) sin^2((2k+1)theta) + (|T minus S|/(N-M)) cos^2((2k+1)theta), theta=asin(sqrt(M/N)); uniform for M=0 or N.
